pla-01.prompt: Flat two-dimensional educational illustration. Simple closed shapes, confident dark outlines, solid uniform fill colors. No gradients, shading, perspective rendering effects or texture. The verb WINNING a race. A runner has just finished first, breaking the single taut plain finish tape with their chest, arms raised in joy, another runner several paces behind them. Entire runners and both compact finish posts visible on a small portion of running track isolated on white. No podium numbers, banners, medals with writing, bibs or sponsor logos. Blank solid-color athletic clothing and smooth plain sneakers. A smiling runner in a green top crossing a red finish tape with hands in the air. A runner in orange is still behind. Two slim posts, short strip of lane, no numbers. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background, show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. IMPORTANT: zoom the composition OUT. Leave roughly ONE SIXTH of canvas width on both the left and right and generous WHITE space above and below. No object or person's extremity touches an edge. No border. Absolutely no text, lettering, digits, writing or pseudo-writing, labels, watermarks, brand marks, logos or emblems anywhere. One clear composition.
